'''Raider Two''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the second member of [[Raider Squadron]].

During [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], when trying to help [[Crimson Jack's battlecruiser]] capture the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], an unknown individual flew as Raider Two.
